items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy, good pal of mine. ... I know them guys. We hung out.

ctx.x: No, they don't get that drunk. They would get scalded so fast it wasn't even funny.

Jimmy, good pal of mine. He play up there at the Savoy with Chick Webb. Yeah, he was something else. Jimmy Harrison, Big Jimmy. He big cat about as big as you. Jimmy's a little taller than you, I think. He -- Big Sid the drummer and Big Jimmy, he could play some trombone too. He's something else. I know them guys. We hung out.
He and Jack Teagarden used to hang out together.
